title: JRE 2471 - Mark Normand
guestBio: Mark Normand is a stand-up comedian, actor, and co-host of the podcasts “Tuesdays with Stories!” and “We Might Be Drunk.” His new special, “None Too Pleased,” is streaming on Netflix.
tldr: Mark Normand's new Netflix special 'None Too Pleased' hit number 5 and he's pushing for number 1 amid saturated comedy market with 19 specials dropping daily
Joe and Mark discuss AI deepfakes of Netanyahu released by Israel, analyzing suspicious details like the coffee cup not spilling and fake writing on signs
Conversation covers geopolitical tensions including Iran, Israel, Ukraine, and mentions Netanyahu's brother being killed in a missile strike
Mark explains he took 8 months off drinking, realized the club lifestyle was exhausting, and recently got back into it after a reset
Joe and Mark debate the White House lawn fight card, discussing security nightmares, outdoor fighting conditions, and joking about politician fight matchups like AOC vs Boebert

Extended tangent into ASMR-style content including street food cooking videos from Afghanistan, horse hoof cleaning, sheep shearing, and the bizarre coincidence of Dennis the Menace being created independently in UK and US on the same day in 1951
recap:
Mark Normand rolls up to talk about his new Netflix special 'None Too Pleased' which just hit number five on the charts. He's trying to push it to number one, but the comedy market is completely saturated now. There's 19 comedy specials dropping daily across YouTube, Hulu, Netflix, and who knows where else. Add in TikToks, Reels, Shorts, and all the other content fighting for attention, and it's basically impossible to cut through the noise anymore. Joe sympathizes and points out there's just too much to pay attention to in general between shows, wars, politics, and OnlyFans.

The conversation quickly pivots to some wild geopolitical stuff. Mark brings up these AI videos of Netanyahu that Israel released, which look completely fake. They break down the footage frame by frame, noting the coffee cup stays at the exact same level no matter how he moves it, the writing on signs isn't even real, and his face has this weird beauty filter effect. It's legitimately bizarre that a government would release something this obviously AI-generated. Joe and Mark theorize Netanyahu might actually be dead, especially since his brother just got killed in a missile strike. They go back and forth on whether he's actually alive, and Mark mentions seeing Netanyahu in front of people recently, so maybe he's still around. Either way, the whole thing is weird as hell.

This leads into deeper geopolitical discussion about Iran, Israel, Ukraine, and how the Strait of Hormuz is now completely closed because Iran keeps bombing shipping routes. Joe brings up how insane it is that precision strikes keep hitting schools and civilian targets. Mark notes that Netanyahu's basically having the time of his life with all this conflict because it keeps him out of prison on corruption charges. Without a war, he'd be indicted immediately.

Mark drops that he took eight months off alcohol after realizing the club lifestyle was absolutely destroying him. He was drinking every night, felt like garbage the next day at the gym, and just couldn't understand why he was doing that to himself. So he quit completely for eight months, then had a glass of wine with dinner and realized he actually likes it again. Now he's back in moderation, which is clearly working better for him.

The White House lawn fight that's supposedly happening gets pretty thoroughly roasted. Mark's not thrilled about it being a security nightmare. Outdoor fights suck in general because of weather, bugs, and visibility issues. Joe brings up the one outside fight he was part of in Abu Dhabi was a nightmare with insects the size of birds flying around. They joke that the card is actually pretty good but people are complaining because they hyped it as the greatest ever. Then they get into who would win if you replaced the fighters with politicians. Mark thinks RFK would win everything, Joe thinks Jasmine Crockett would destroy everyone, and they land on the idea that she'd pull her wig off and stuff it in someone's mouth.
